data_principal_rights.name: Data Principal Rights
data_principal_rights.max_penalty: ₹200 Crores (Schedule Item 1 — Sections 11, 12 & 14; Section 13 grievance redressal is not separately listed, see notes)

ai_governance.name: AI & ML Governance
ai_governance.sections: Interpretive — not a distinct DPDPA chapter; grounded in Section 8 general obligations

cross_border.name: Cross-Border Data Transfer
cross_border.max_penalty: Not directly scheduled; indirect via Board directions (Item 8, ₹250 Crores) if unresolved after notice

findings.description: Hardcoded plaintext credential or secret detected.
findings.remediation: Move secrets to environment variables or a vault service.

findings.description: SSL/TLS certificate verification is explicitly disabled.
findings.remediation: Remove SSL verification bypass. Use proper CA certificates.

findings.description: PII field names found inside logging statements.
findings.remediation: Mask or redact PII before logging.

findings.description: Third-party analytics/tracking script detected without consent wrapper.
findings.dpdpa_section: Section 5 & 6 — Valid consent required before tracking
findings.remediation: Wrap tracker initialization inside a consent check.

findings.dpdpa_section: Section 5 — Consent must be freely given via clear affirmative action
findings.remediation: Remove pre-checked states from consent checkboxes.

findings.description: PII field names found in ML training pipeline.
findings.dpdpa_section: Section 8 (general obligations, applied to ML pipelines) — not a standalone statutory AI chapter
findings.penalty: Up to ₹200 Crores (Schedule Item 1/2, via Section 8)
findings.remediation: Remove raw PII from feature vectors. Anonymize before model ingestion.

findings.dpdpa_section: Section 16 — Cross-border transfer restrictions (blacklist framework; no country currently restricted)
findings.penalty: Not directly scheduled; indirect via Board directions (Item 8, ₹250 Crores) if unresolved after notice
findings.remediation: Verify DPA coverage. Plan for data localization contingency.

global_warnings.description: No data retention, TTL, or automated purge logic found.
global_warnings.dpdpa_section: Section 8(7) — Storage limitation; data must be erased when purpose is fulfilled
global_warnings.remediation: Implement database TTL triggers and data lifecycle policies.

global_warnings.description: No user data erasure/account deletion endpoint found.
global_warnings.dpdpa_section: Section 12 — Right to Correction, Completion, Updation & Erasure
global_warnings.remediation: Implement a 'Delete My Account' endpoint with cascade deletion.

global_warnings.description: No user data export/download endpoint found.

global_warnings.dpdpa_section: Section 8(10) — internal grievance redressal mechanism (Section 13 is the related Data Principal right)
global_warnings.remediation: Establish a dedicated privacy contact and ticketing system.

global_warnings.description: No rate limiting logic found for ML inference APIs.
global_warnings.dpdpa_section: Section 8(4)/(5) (general & security obligations, applied to ML inference endpoints) — not a standalone statutory AI chapter
global_warnings.penalty: Up to ₹200 Crores (Schedule Item 1/2, via Section 8)
global_warnings.remediation: Implement API rate limiting on all inference endpoints.

global_warnings.description: No breach/incident notification handling code found.
global_warnings.dpdpa_section: Section 8(6) — Mandatory breach notification to the Board and affected Data Principals
global_warnings.remediation: Implement incident response module with DPBI notification.
